worldcombat.skill.aquaring.summary: Wraps a veil of water around itself that surges every few seconds to restore a small share of maximum health. The veil lasts on its own or until cleared, and never requires standing still.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.use.0: Give yourself a steady sustain line in a long fight
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.use.1: Heal while backing off and stretch the war of attrition
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.use.2: Open the veil stronger in the rain
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.description.0: The veil surges every %2$s, restoring %1$s of maximum health (capped at full).
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.description.1: The veil lasts %1$s; derived from Special Defence.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.description.2: The veil encircles the body out to %1$s blocks; it ends on its own timer or when cleared.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.spring.on: Spring: interval x0.65 and pulse x1.35 (faster, bigger), at the cost of veil duration x0.7.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.spring.off: Trickle: baseline interval and pulse, veil duration x1.25 - slower but longer and steadier.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.timing: A self move; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.growth.0: At level %1$s the veil lasts up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.growth.1: At level %1$s the veil lasts further up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.preference.sp: On (spring): faster and bigger surges (interval x0.65, pulse x1.35), veil duration x0.7. Off (trickle): slower but longer (duration x1.25). Similar total, different situations.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.preference.ai: Below this health ratio the companion schedules Aqua Ring as sustain; lower prefers to keep attacking, higher opens the veil at the first wound.
